description: Check whether a string is valid Base64 and describe it, without returning the decoded content. Uses the same lenient rules as base64_decode. Returns JSON: valid, variant (standard if + or / occurs, url if - or _ occurs, mixed if both, either if neither), padded (whether the '=' padding is complete) and bytes (decoded size); or valid: false with the error base64_decode would report, such as the offending character and its position.

data.description: The string to check. A data: URI is accepted too.

name: base64_validate
title: Base64 validate
